text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE FIRED: edge-proxy.tls.handshake.rate high in eu-west-1 for service=inference-api. 5xx spike ~22% from 16:04 UTC, TLS handshake timeouts, many unique client IPs. PagerDuty: https://pd.example/alerts/PD12345. Auto-escalation scheduled in 6m.

pagerduty: Alert PD12345 created for inference-api (severity: P1). Assigning to #oncall-sre.

alex: acked the page. I'm on it. Starting triage — will check ALB target health + proxy logs.

sara: seeing similar in observability — spike aligned with a DNS rollout at 15:58 (we shortened TTLs for a cert rotation). Could be partial propagation causing SNI mismatch/path to some old certs.

miguel: grabbing ALB health quickly, past 15m:
```
TargetGroup: tg-inference-eu
  healthy: 48
  unhealthy: 52
  last_checked: 16:06:12 UTC
  reason: TLS handshake failure / connection reset
```
Noticing backend pods show repeated tls: handshake error in proxy logs (snippet below):
```
2026-03-15T16:03:49Z proxy[edge]: tls: handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate
2026-03-15T16:03:50Z proxy[edge]: connection reset by peer
```

oncall-bob: tagging @alex @sara @miguel — quick ask: can we reduce traffic to the affected ALB and shift weight to eu-west-2 standby? If the issue is propagation/sni mismatch that's safest.

alex: agree. ops-jen can you run the weight-shift plan (route 30% -> eu-west-2, 70% remain) and monitor 5xx rate? If 5xx drops in 2 mins, we continue shifting.

ops-jen: running route weight change now. Command: `aws elbv2 modify-listener --listener-arn arn:... --default-actions '[{"Type":"forward","ForwardConfig":{"TargetGroups":[{"TargetGroupArn":"tg-inference-eu-west-1","Weight":70},{"TargetGroupArn":"tg-inference-eu-west-2","Weight":30}]}}]'`
ops-jen: done. Verifying metrics...

miguel: after 60s, EU west-1 5xx rate down from 22% -> 9%. TLS handshake errors reduced in logs. Looks promising.

incident-bot: PD Alert PD12345 acknowledged by alex. Escalation suspended.

pagerduty: Note: escalation policy paused after acknowledgement.

sara: still seeing some DNS-related hits to old edge IPs in the CDN logs — TTL was 60s but some resolvers still returning cached entries. That could explain residual failures. Will coordinate with CDN team to purge problematic edge nodes.

alex: we should also trigger an immediate cert reissue check and verify that all edge proxies have the new cert (thumbprint 3f:8a:... ). Miguel can you grep pods for cert thumbprint?

miguel: running: `kubectl exec -n edge $(kubectl get po -n edge -l app=edge-proxy -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -- cat /etc/ssl/certs/edge.pem | sha256sum`
matches: 3f8a... for most pods, but two pods in eu-west-1 still show old thumbprint. Those pods restarted ~15:45 due to an autoscaler event — likely missed rolling update.

oncall-bob: plan: 1) drain the two stale pods (kubectl drain + delete) 2) purge CDN cache for impacted POPs 3) keep traffic shifted while we validate 4) follow-up RCA doc. Who volunteers for pod drain?

ops-jen: draining the two pods now: `kubectl cordon pod-edge-77 && kubectl delete pod pod-edge-77` — pods terminating, new pods pulling correct cert.

miguel: new pods up, cert thumbprint 3f8a... all good. ALB healthy -> healthy: 98, unhealthy: 2. 5xx back to baseline ~0.7%.

alex: thanks team. I'll hand the alert to oncall-bob for verification/monitoring and post-incident runbook. @oncall-bob — taking the PD handoff now.

oncall-bob: I've taken ownership of PD12345 and will watch for 20m before closing. Noted customer impact: intermittent inference API failures for EU customers between 15:58-16:10 UTC, estimated affected requests ~3.2% of EU traffic. No data exposure.

sara: opening postmortem ticket: PM-4573. Preliminary cause: staggered pod restarts + CDN DNS caching + cert rotation timing led to small window of mismatched certs causing TLS handshake failures. Action items: strengthen rollout gating for edge certs, ensure rolling restarts after autoscaler events, add cert thumbprint verification to deploy pipeline, CDN purge automation for cert rotations.

incident-bot: PD12345 status updated: mitigated. Will auto-close in 2h if no regressions.

alex: closing notes — customer impact slice and internal timeline will go into PM-4573. Great coordination. :thumbsup:

ops-jen: leaving a short command snippet in the ticket for ops playbook:
```
# quick weight shift
aws elbv2 modify-listener --listener-arn $LISTENER --default-actions '...'
# drain pod
kubectl delete pod $POD --namespace=edge
# verify cert thumbprint
kubectl exec -n edge $POD -- cat /etc/ssl/certs/edge.pem | sha256sum
```

miguel: marking logs for retention for 48h for the incident window (16:00-16:15 UTC).

oncall-bob: closing PD alert in 20m if no new signs. Thanks all.

(threads like this are typically short; follow-up PM will cover long-term mitigations.)
